project.name: drishti-banking-module
project.description: The banking module's sources, laid out to build on their own (docs/architecture/KERNEL_AND_MODULES.md section 8.10): banking-compute (the maths: VaR, exposure, FRTB-SA, SIMM, sensitivities) and banking-service (the services, storage, Spring wiring and API). Built alone with `./mvnw -f modules/banking/pom.xml` against installed kernel artefacts. The kernel internals banking still reaches are listed in kernel-internals.txt (BankingReachTest keeps the list true and only shrinking). Banking still loads in-process from the fat jar (drishti-app); it becomes a .dmod in wave 2.
